paper_title: Spectral Editing of Activations for Large Language Model Alignment
caption: MC1 scores of SEA by using a different number of demonstrations. A higher score indicates a better performance. We find that SEA can start to positively improve the baseline with only 25 demonstrations on both TruthfulQA and BBQ for the 7B LLaMA-2-Chat model.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the accuracy scores of Spectral Editing of Activations (SEA) across a range of demonstration numbers for the LLaMA-2-Chat-7B model, with accuracy measured on the BBQ dataset. The horizontal axis, labeled "#Demonstrations," is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1500, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 250. The vertical axis, labeled "Accuracy," is a linear scale ranging from approximately 40 to 55, with tick marks at intervals of 5. The plot shows four lines: a dark blue squared-exponential line representing Squared-Exponential TanH, starting at approximately 48 and ending at approximately 53; a light blue solid line representing TanH, beginning at approximately 46 and concluding at approximately 48; a purple dashed line representing ELU, beginning at approximately 42 and concluding at approximately 46; and a pink dashed line representing L.L.aMA-2-chat-7B, commencing at approximately 48 and concluding at approximately 51.
